_comment: Every Terraform root folder CI knows about. fmt/validate/tflint run on all of them. plan: true = plan on every PR. apply: 'auto' = apply on merge to main, 'manual' = apply only from a Run workflow click (promotion), false = never in CI. env picks the CI roles (steel-ledger-<env>-plan/-apply) and the GitHub Environment. 'why' explains anything switched off.

roots.name: bootstrap
roots.why: Never applied by CI: the pipeline must not edit its own permissions. Apply by hand.

roots.name: dev-mac
roots.why: EC2 Mac. Applying creates a mac2.metal host with a 24h minimum bill, and its tfvars hold a home IP. Off until TSL-44 (rent-a-mac).
